mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive market adjustment that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 2.0, or inflation decelerates within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds historical averages, signaling robust labor market strength that supports equity valuations and drives positive 60-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat when PAYEMS remains above its rolling average for at least 90 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both HOUST (industrial production) and GDPC1 (personal consumption) above trend suggests expanding economic demand, which elevates corporate earnings expectations and produces positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and GDPC1 are above their 6-month moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both proxies are above trend for at least 10 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO (industrial production) index below 95 triggers a supply-side weakness that raises perceived risk, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive when INDPRO < 95 for at least 7 consecutive sessions.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains persistently below 1%, it signals accommodative policy that lowers real rates, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when FEDFUNDS > 1.0 for the subsequent 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE (unemployment rate) below 4.5% signals tight labor markets, prompting equity risk-on flows and positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE remains above 4.5% for the next 15 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in both RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (industrial production) below trend indicate weakening demand, which predicts negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both RSAFS and HOUST fall below their 4-week moving averages
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative when both proxies remain above trend for at least 7 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of falling CPIAUCSL inflation (below 1.5% for 3 months) suggests disinflation, lowering policy uncertainty and generating positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when CPIAUCSL > 1.5 for the following 60 days.
